title: Nvidia Just Delivered Massive News for These 10 Stocks
creator: BWB - Business With Brian
summary: A companion to his earlier video the same day: Brian maps Nvidia's latest AI news across the three checkpoints of his agent-safety thesis — chip-level (Nvidia's on-card checkpoint in Vera Rubin racks), network and software — and re-runs his 10-stock signal ladder. The stances are identical to 'Rogue AI Is Already Here' (analyzed ~13:57): NVDA BUY a lot (PEG 0.36, own system forecasts ~36%/yr over 3 years, no analyst profit cuts since July; build a position over time), HPE BUY a little (~16x next year's earnings, networking orders +36% incl. Juniper), LSCC HOLD (cautiously optimistic, 58x next year's earnings, wait for a better price), ZS HOLD (wait for its first GAAP operating profit in the quarter ending October, then it gets 'much more interesting'), MSFT HOLD (great business at 45c operating profit per dollar and ~18% growth, but prefer a pullback), FTNT SELL/trim (~40x next year's earnings despite a great business), CSCO SELL/trim (price ahead of the business, 50-day heading down), PANW SELL/trim ('extremely hot' at ~92x next year's earnings; system forecasts it giving back gains), CRWD SELL/trim (most expensive of the 10 at 48x sales; 'no-brainer' versus ZS growing as fast at 9x sales), and CRM CONDITIONAL_BUY (~$250; cheapest of the 10 at ~14x next year's earnings, only if it holds the 50-day and pushes through ~$250 by late October). No stance flips within the day — and the Oct 3 collab flips (PANW and CRWD BUY→SELL, MSFT BUY→HOLD) carry over.

calls.base: ~80-90% of AI chips; 100+ companies on its agent-safety platform; system forecast +36%/yr for 3 yrs.
calls.bear: Margin to slip to ~71-72c per dollar by January as memory gets scarce; earnings may be near a peak.
